block_mesh - Rust - Docs.rs
A fast and simple meshing algorithm that produces a single quad for every visible face of a block. visible_ block_ faces_ with_ voxel_ view Same as visible_block_faces, with the additional ability to interpret the array as some other type. Use this if you want to mesh the same array multiple times with different sets of voxels being visible.
